style.en: Speak in a clear, articulate, warm, and professional International English accent, like a helpful university instructor walking students through their midterm assignment submission portal. Pacing is natural, encouraging, and confident.

hl: Anyone with the link can view

en: Welcome to the IOMBA Midterm Assignment Submission Portal.
In this quick guide, we will walk you through how to submit your midterm project smoothly.

dir.en: Clear and structured, explaining the deliverables.

en: Your midterm deliverable is submitted via a single Google Doc link.
Inside your document, include your project description, paste your live project link, and add a YouTube link if you recorded a video.

dir.en: Emphasise the critical permission step with seriousness and clarity.

en: Here is the most critical step: ensure your Google Doc sharing permission is set to 'Anyone with the link can view'.
If your document remains private, evaluators cannot access or grade your work.

dir.en: Demonstrative, guiding through the form fields.

en: On the portal, enter your Student ID, name, project title, and your Google Doc link.
Pasting your live link and YouTube link on the form is optional, but helps us grade faster!
You will immediately receive a submission timestamp.
Need to revise? Resubmitting with the same Student ID updates your previous submission automatically. Best of luck on your midterm report!
